title: verify-15-gates: Expand verify to enumerate all 15 verification gates
description: Feature P1-9. Master §63 (Plan Verifier and Accepted Artifacts) defines 15 verification gates: profile, shape, names, references, expressions, control-flow, bounded, budgets, contracts, taint, idempotency, durability, capabilities, results, observability. Today vb_cli/src/commands/verify.rs:45-134 run_verification runs only 4-5 named checks. VerifyError has 6 variants, no per-gate attribution. The verify command is the master §75 'hero command' — its output must enumerate every gate. This bead: (1) extends VerifyError to include a Gate { gate: u8, name: &'static str, code: u32, message: String } variant; (2) walks all 15 gates in run_verification; (3) gates 1-8 are in place; 9-13 exist as validators; 14-15 need new validate_gate_14_result_output and validate_gate_15_observability in vb_validate/src/gates.rs. Depends on P0-4 (the action contract gate needs the contract to be well-defined).

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL enumerate all 15 verification gates in every `vb verify` invocation, with per-gate pass/fail status
THE SYSTEM SHALL attach a stable gate code (u32) to every diagnostic so AI agents can match on the code

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb verify workflow.yaml --profile strict`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a VerificationReport with 15 entries in `checks`, one per gate, each with status (pass/fail), code, and message
THE SYSTEM SHALL emit Gate { gate: 10, code: 0x0406, name: 'taint', message: '...' }

unwanted.condition: IF a verification gate exists in code but is not enumerated in run_verification
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently skip it; the proptest must fail
unwanted.because: Master §63: 'A workflow must pass every gate to produce an accepted artifact' — skipping a gate defeats the contract

unwanted.condition: IF a workflow has no action contracts but verify reports 'all 15 gates pass'
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mark the workflow as accepted; gate 9 (contracts) must fail
unwanted.because: Master §63: gate 9 (action contract) is required; missing contracts is a hard failure

preconditions: YAML parses under the strict profile
postconditions: Each check has: gate: u8, name: &'static str, code: u32, status: Pass | Fail { reason: String }, evidence: Option<String>
invariants: The 15 gate codes are stable: 0x0101..=0x010F (one per gate, low byte = gate number)
No gate is reported as 'not evaluated'; every gate gets an explicit Pass or Fail

happy: verify_emits_15_checks_for_valid_workflow: a valid minimal workflow returns 15 entries in checks, all Pass
verify_failing_gate_10_emits_typed_error: a workflow with a Secret-tainted Finish result fails gate 10 with Gate { gate: 10, code: 0x0406 }
verify_failing_gate_9_emits_action_contract_error: a workflow with a Do node but no contract fails gate 9 (depends on P0-4)
error: verify_with_no_yaml_file_returns_io_error: a missing file returns IoError, not a 15-gate report
verify_with_malformed_yaml_returns_profile_error: gate 1 (profile) fails with a profile error
edge: verify_gate_coverage_proptest: proptest over 100 random workflows, assert checks.len() == 15

files: crates/vb_cli/src/commands/verify.rs (VerifyError enum: 6 variants, no per-gate attribution)
crates/vb_validate/src/lib.rs (the public surface for the 15 validators)
patterns: Pattern: existing gate codes 0x0101..=0x0108 (gates 1-8) are already in VerifyError variants
Pattern: existing per-gate attribution is a single (gate: u8, code: u32, reason: String) tuple
questions: Are gates 14 (result/output validator) and 15 (observability) already partially implemented? (Spec: 14 is Implemented per §63; 15 is Partial. Both need explicit validators in gates.rs.)

security_failures.failure: A workflow with a `Do` referencing an action with no contract passes verify because gate 9 is not enumerated
security_failures.prevention: Gate 9 is enumerated; P0-4 makes the contract well-defined

usability_failures.failure: Operator runs `vb verify` and gets a generic 'verification failed' with no per-gate info
usability_failures.prevention: Each gate has a typed result with stable code; the report shows all 15

data_integrity_failures.failure: A gate is reported as Pass but the validator is not actually invoked (silent skip)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Each gate has a mandatory evidence field; the report is a `Vec<GateResult>` not a `HashSet`

integration_failures.failure: External CI script breaks because a new gate was added but the report structure changed
integration_failures.prevention: Report schema is versioned; AI output is YAML with explicit gate numbers; new gates are additive only

phase_2: In vb_cli/src/commands/verify.rs: extend VerifyError with a `Gate { gate: u8, name: &'static str, code: u32, message: String }` variant
In run_verification: walk all 15 gates; emit a VerificationReport with 15 GateResult entries
In vb_validate/src/gates.rs: add validate_gate_14_result_output and validate_gate_15_observability
phase_3: Add a new code range 0x0E01..=0x0F01 for gates 14 and 15
